_doc: Orc (race orc), the MAIN orc gait since 2026-10-17 (Mike: 'very very good'; replaces the 2026-10-14 orc A spec, which git history keeps). Small Mordor or Moria scuttler per Mike's metric orc spec: spine rounded about 40 deg (over the 30 deg combat cap on Mike's request: restyle with --allow-over-cap and watch the attack blend in game), neck nearly horizontal with the head tilted up so the eyes look forward, anterior pelvis tilt, crouch, feet on wide separate tracks with toes out 25 deg, elbows bent 25 deg, arms 12 deg out from the body plus the hand clearance rule, pelvis sway 2x vanilla. Limp: weak (dragged) LEFT leg, strong RIGHT leg, the low leading shoulder on the strong side, 60/40 timing; the run is a forward-falling lope with a long trailing weak leg. low_shoulder_deg 4 on top of clavicle_drop_deg 8 is also over the clavicle cap. The idles keep the 2026-10-14 idle block. Clips taom_orc_* on as_orc_warrior. Read by tools/blender/restyle_human_clip.py. Angles in degrees, distances in metres.

idle._doc: Slow head turns and weight shift; one cycle per clip loop.
